notes: Use one primary action in each local decision area.
Busy state preserves button width.

components.name: Breadcrumb trail
components.use: Dashboard drilldown path and return navigation

selection.bestFor: Choose Breadcrumb trail when the interface needs a wrapping breadcrumb path with native links, a named navigation landmark and a clear current location.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there is only one destination or a flat list would be faster to scan.

notes: Pass the path from broad context to the current location. Earlier items with href render real links; the final item identifies the current page.
The trail uses a named navigation landmark and an ordered list. Separators and icons are decorative, while every meaningful destination has a visible text label.
Items wrap on narrow surfaces rather than dropping intermediate destinations. Native links keep browser navigation and keyboard behavior.
Original Gamma markup and token styles. The demo points at the real Gamma catalogue and component routes; no client state or animation is needed.

references.label: Original
references.role: Original Gamma behavior, markup and token styles; no external component source or assets imported

references.role: Named navigation landmark and current-page breadcrumb semantics

components.name: Search field

selection.bestFor: Choose Search field when the interface needs a labeled native search input with focus-preserving clear and an optional explicit submit action.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the value is not user-editable or when one clear action is enough.

notes: The native search input supports a visible label, optional instructions and a clear action. Clearing returns focus to the input and updates controlled consumers with an empty string.
With onSearch, Enter and the explicit action request the same search. Without it, Enter retains the surrounding form’s normal submit behavior.
The component does not fetch or filter data. The live demo filters catalogue entries locally and shows the last explicit submission so both editing and submission are observable.

Disabled blocks the field and its actions. ReadOnly prevents editing and clearing while allowing the existing query to be searched. Original Gamma layout and token styling; no decorative animation or remote service is involved.

references.label: Original
references.role: Original Gamma behavior, markup and token styles; no external component source or assets imported

references.label: MDN HTML
references.role: Native search input labeling, value and form behavior

components.name: Floating field

selection.bestFor: Choose Floating field when the interface needs a native text field with a label that makes room for the entered value.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the value is not user-editable or when one clear action is enough.

notes: The label stays visible after typing or autofill.
Errors are linked to the input with aria-describedby.
The password toggle is a separate native button.

references.label: Spell UI
references.role: Floating label reference

components.name: Search combobox

selection.bestFor: Choose Search combobox when the interface needs a searchable single-choice field with disabled options, clear, and explicit loading and recovery states.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the value is not user-editable or when one clear action is enough.

notes: Type to filter; Arrow Up/Down opens the list and moves through enabled options, Enter commits, Escape closes, and Tab closes while leaving focus to continue naturally. Alt+Home/End reaches the first/last option without overriding native caret movement.

The editable input keeps focus while aria-activedescendant identifies the active option. Disabled choices remain visible. Clear resets the committed value and query. Blur/Escape discard uncommitted input without changing the choice.

The list uses the browser’s native popover top layer while staying beneath the component in the DOM, preserving nearest-scope tokens and avoiding clipping. It measures viewport space, flips above when necessary, and follows scroll/resize.

For remote results, control query, set filter={false}, and supply loading/error/onRetry. Requests, cancellation and stale-result handling belong to the consumer. Enter retries an open load error; the demo only simulates a local delay.
Original DOM/React implementation distilled from PanelUI’s MIT-licensed native Combobox. This component supports a single predefined option. Reduced motion removes entry fade and spinner rotation.

references.label: PanelUI
references.role: Editable field filtering, supporting option copy, selected indicator, clear action and loading states.

references.label: PanelUI source
references.role: MIT source reviewed for searchable single-choice behavior and anchored overlay; independently implemented with React DOM.

notes: Use for immediate state changes, not form submission.
The native checkbox remains the interaction owner.

Each tab controls one labeled panel.

components.name: Action menu

selection.bestFor: Use Action menu for a compact set of project or row actions when the trigger should stay visible and shortcuts help repeat users.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it for a single action or a primary decision; keep one obvious button in that case.

notes: The trigger is a menu button. Enter, Space, or ArrowDown opens it and focuses the first enabled action.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp cycle enabled actions; Home and End jump; Escape or Tab closes and returns focus to the trigger.
Disabled actions stay visible but are skipped by keyboard navigation and do not fire.
Reduced motion removes the panel arrival; focus and state changes stay intact.

references.label: Component Gallery
references.role: Menu-button structure and example review.

references.label: SaaS Interface
references.role: SaaS menu and picker pattern reference.

components.name: Context menu

selection.bestFor: Choose Context menu when the interface needs a right-click action menu with a keyboard entry point, grouped items, shortcuts, and viewport clamping.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there is only one destination or a flat list would be faster to scan.

notes: Right-click opens at the pointer; Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens at a stable point inside the surface.
The menu renders in a portal, clamps to the viewport, and closes on outside pointer, scroll, resize, Escape, or Tab.
ArrowUp and ArrowDown move by roving focus, Home and End jump to the edges, Enter or Space activates, and letter keys jump to a matching action.
Disabled actions stay visible but cannot be focused or activated. Danger actions use a semantic color mix and still keep readable text.
The menu is a real floating surface, so its elevation shadow is deliberate. Reduced motion does not affect the immediate open/close.
Original React implementation informed by the shadcn/ui context-menu pattern and the WAI-ARIA menu button guidance; no source or artwork is copied.

references.label: shadcn/ui
references.role: Context menu grouping and portal reference.

references.label: WAI APG
references.role: Keyboard menu pattern reference.

components.name: Side sheet

selection.bestFor: Choose Side sheet when the interface needs edit page settings in a modal panel with a scrollable body, pinned actions and deliberate focus return.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there is only one destination or a flat list would be faster to scan.

notes: Uses showModal() on an in-scope native dialog: focus is contained and background content is inert without moving the panel out of its design-system token island.
The heading receives initial focus. Tab reaches the close button, body fields and footer. Escape, the close button or the backdrop returns focus to the opener; external blur is not pulled back.
Body scroll locks are reference counted and restore the previous inline overflow on close and unmount. Header and footer stay visible while the body scrolls.
Pass open and onOpenChange for save/cancel forms. Form data belongs to the consumer; dismissing the demo discards drafts, while Save applies the preview settings.
The detached panel fits the viewport on narrow screens. Entry uses token timing; close is immediate. Reduced motion removes sheet and backdrop entry animations.
Original React DOM implementation informed by the MIT PanelUI Sheet. SideSheet supports left and right edges; swipe dismissal, nested sheet staging, and top/bottom variants are outside this API.

references.label: PanelUI
references.role: Detached edge panel, modal focus, pinned header/footer and dismissal reference

references.label: PanelUI source
references.role: MIT source inspected; original Gamma native dialog implementation without Base UI dependency

components.name: Data table

selection.bestFor: Choose Data table when the interface needs search, filter, sort, select, and expand rows in a reusable accessible table.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the content must be selected or operated; use an interactive control instead.

notes: Adapted from Spectrum UI, Apache-2.0, pinned to acdc998c64829f8ae037be48e3c273ccc8d71f60; retains the original Motion springs, layout reordering, filter thumb, and count transitions.
Tab reaches controls; Enter or Space activates buttons. Focus the table region for arrows, Home/End, Shift selection, and Cmd/Ctrl+A or C. Native checkbox and switch controls remain reachable.
Reduced motion or animate=false removes row layout motion and disclosure/count transitions. Tables scroll horizontally where content needs room; secondary columns hide at upstream breakpoints.
Data stays local. Supply loading and emptyState from your app; asynchronous requests, authorization, and persistence remain consumer-owned.

references.label: Spectrum UI
references.role: Apache-2.0 source adaptation; original spring motion, Gamma token styling and supplied data.

references.label: Spectrum UI source
references.role: Pinned upstream implementation; modified source retains attribution.

components.name: Filter bar

selection.bestFor: Use Filter bar when a list needs multi-select facets, removable active constraints, and a visible count.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there are one or two fixed views; a segmented control or tabs may be faster.

notes: Tab opens the trigger and moves through native checkboxes. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the trigger.
Active filters become removable chips; each removal or clear returns focus to the trigger.
The active count is a polite live region, and every checkbox keeps its native checked state.
Reduced motion removes the panel arrival; selection and focus behavior stay unchanged.

references.label: SaaS Interface
references.role: SaaS filter and list refinement reference.

components.name: Tree navigator

selection.bestFor: Choose Tree navigator when the interface needs explore and select a nested hierarchy with guide lines, independent disclosure, and complete keyboard navigation.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there is only one destination or a flat list would be faster to scan.

notes: Tab enters one tree item. Up/Down move through visible enabled rows; Home/End reach the first or last row. Typing a label prefix moves focus.
Right opens a branch or enters its children; Left closes it or returns to its parent. These directions mirror in RTL. Enter and Space select the focused row.
Click a row to select it, or its chevron to expand without selecting. Selection does not follow focus, and opening a branch preserves selection.
Disabled items and their descendants are skipped by arrow navigation. If a focused branch collapses or a focused node disappears, focus returns to its nearest available ancestor.
Only open children are mounted. This component is synchronous, single-select, and unvirtualized; owners supply updated node data and handle navigation in onValueChange.
Only disclosure rotation animates; reduced motion removes transitions. All interactive colors, shapes, typography, focus, and motion use Gamma design-system tokens.
Icon and meta slots should contain noninteractive content. Stable unique IDs are required for selection, expansion, focus, and React keys.

references.label: PanelUI
references.role: Nested disclosure, guide lines, and independent expansion/selection reference; original DOM implementation.

references.label: PanelUI source
references.role: Reviewed React Native construction; no source or assets copied.

components.name: Calendar picker
components.use: Civil-date selection within a time-range workflow

selection.bestFor: Choose Calendar picker when the interface needs a six-week calendar for choosing one date, with bounded month browsing and unavailable days.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the value is not user-editable or when one clear action is enough.

notes: Arrow keys move through available dates. Home/End reach available dates within the current week; Page Up/Down change month, with Shift changing year. Enter or Space selects; selecting the date again clears it.

Values are Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD civil dates, independent of timezone. The month is YYYY-MM. Supply valid bounds with minDate <= maxDate; an empty month remains keyboard reachable and announces that no dates are available.

The grid always occupies six weeks. Outside days are deliberately nonselectable; arrow navigation can change the month. Controlled month consumers must apply onMonthChange to complete navigation across a month boundary.
Today marks the local date at mount. Styling uses the nearest Gamma design-system scope. Reduced motion removes hover transitions; selection remains visible.
Original DOM/React implementation distilled from PanelUI’s MIT-licensed native Calendar. This focused component supports a single date rather than range, multiple, or alternate calendar systems.

references.label: PanelUI
references.role: Six-week layout, centered caption, unavailable-day rules and bounded single-date selection.

references.label: PanelUI source
references.role: MIT source reviewed for calendar structure and selection behavior; independently implemented with React DOM.

components.name: Tooltip

selection.bestFor: Use Tooltip for a short, non-interactive annotation attached to a single trigger that needs clarification on hover, focus, or tap.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it for long guidance or interactive content; use a popover, help panel, or inline message.

notes: Hover opens after a short delay; keyboard focus opens immediately and Escape closes without moving focus.
Placement is measured against the viewport. The bubble flips to a side with room, slides along the boundary, and keeps its arrow pointing at the trigger.
A warm handoff after closing skips the open delay, so moving across adjacent triggers stays responsive.
The bubble uses width max-content with a 240px cap, wraps long words, and scrolls a taller description instead of escaping the viewport.
The bubble stays mounted with aria-hidden while closed; it enters and exits with opacity, scale, and a short directional slide.
Reduced motion removes the scale, translation, and transition; the text still appears immediately.
Keep the content to a phrase or one sentence; interactive content belongs in a popover.

references.label: Component Gallery
references.role: Tooltip taxonomy and example review; behavior reproduced independently.

references.label: Tip Glide
references.role: Auto placement, boundary clamping, warm handoffs, and enter/exit motion reference.

components.name: Badge

selection.bestFor: Use Badge for a short status, count, or metadata label that belongs inside a sentence or row.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it for actions or filters; a badge is not interactive. Use a chip or button when selection matters.

notes: A badge is not interactive and has no keyboard path; use a button or filter chip when selection is needed.
The dot and icon are decorative; the visible label carries status, count, or metadata for screen readers.
All tones map to design-system tokens and inherit the surrounding system.
There is no animation; reduced motion does not change the badge.

references.label: Component Gallery
references.role: Badge taxonomy and tone/variant reference.

components.name: Empty state

selection.bestFor: Choose Empty state when the interface needs a quiet empty surface that explains the context and gives the user a clear next action.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when the content must be selected or operated; use an interactive control instead.

notes: Read context with consumer-owned actions: the authored moment is replacing an empty surface with real content after an action. The component itself owns no loading or data state.
Use a concrete title and one useful next step. Empty collections, filtered results and errors need different copy; loading belongs to a loading indicator rather than this surface.

Actions remain native buttons or links supplied as children, with visible focus styling. An icon is decorative; do not put essential information in it. The title is an h3, so place the surface within an appropriate heading hierarchy.
No client boundary or animation is needed. Reduced motion shows the same static layout. The live collection demo creates and removes local preview content.

references.label: Original
references.role: Original Gamma contextual copy, layout and action slot; no external component source or assets imported

references.label: WAI Forms
references.role: Meaningful visible labels for consumer-owned action controls

components.name: Pagination

selection.bestFor: Choose Pagination when the interface needs a bounded page selector with previous and next actions, current-page semantics and compact numbered ranges.
selection.avoidWhen: Avoid it when there is only one destination or a flat list would be faster to scan.

notes: The control owns only page selection. Fetching data, updating the displayed collection and synchronizing a URL remain consumer concerns.
Current-page semantics accompany native numbered buttons. Previous and next are disabled at the bounds; omitted ranges use noninteractive ellipses.
The live demo paginates real Gamma catalogue names four at a time. Controlled consumers should keep page and totalPages consistent when their collection changes.
Buttons retain native keyboard interaction and do not submit forms. No motion, external component implementation or routing dependency is required.

references.label: Original
references.role: Original Gamma behavior, markup and token styles; no external component source or assets imported

references.label: MDN ARIA
references.role: Current-page identification within a navigation set
